page.layout: One block of text, one printed page on the scan. Heading "PRAEFATIO." at top centre. Running text below it, followed by the ornament, the signature at lower right, and the catchword "AD" at the foot.

main_text.head: PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: progredieris: quod si feceris, dubium non est, quin aliquando tibi honori[?], a-micis utilitati, & Reipub. emolumento sis futurus: quod fecit Deus trinus & unus, omnium bonorum inventor, inceptor, perfector. Datæ Spirae 4. Non. Februarii, Anni Salvatoris nostri, 1583.

page.notes: The word after "honori" is badly printed and may be "honoris" or "honori"; marked [?]. "li" in "quod li feceris" is read as "si" and marked [?] in the text. Asterisk ornament transcribed as printed. Line-end hyphens in "a-micis" and "inven-tor" and "no-stri" are printed. No page number or running head printed.
